themes.title: Far-Right Surge in European Regional Elections and Governance
themes.blurb: Far-right parties maintain strong polling leads in key European regions, with AfD in Germany, RN in France, and Vox in Spain all positioning for electoral gains. In Italy, Fratelli d'Italia faces internal dissent but remains dominant in coalition governance.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 40%, threatening to become first far-right state government since WWII.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads polls for 2027 presidential race, proposing referendum to ban Islamic veils in public spaces.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leads polls in Ceuta with 31.8% and maintains strong influence in Andalusia coalition government amid Ceuta migrant crisis.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni's government marks 1,412 days in power, longest since WWII, amid internal Lega party rebellion challenging Salvini's leadership.

themes.title: Immigration and Border Security as Political Wedges

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna

themes.title: Populist Right Battles Media Bias and Digital Censorship
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and parties across the U.S. and Europe decry media bias and push back against digital censorship, with MAGA-aligned figures in the U.S. and SD in Sweden framing mainstream media as hostile to their narratives.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration targets media and digital platforms, proposing tax incentives for entertainment industry and pushing narratives of media bias against conservative voices.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD faces scrutiny over media ownership and digital content moderation, with party leaders criticizing mainstream media's coverage of migration and cultural issues.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces backlash over BBC's live broadcast of anti-Nigel Farage remarks at Reading Festival, fueling accusations of media bias against the party.
